selection.policy: Seed from standard Go-mirrored /v3/ and /v3alpha/ schemas plus Envoy annotations and both rate-limit configuration schemas; take the complete transitive import closure. Inventory all Envoy API schemas. Defer broad legacy/contrib catalogs under T28. Version directories do not filter transitive dependencies.
selection.scopeNote: Schema bindings do not imply implementation of every declared service. Runtime scope remains the root-library parity matrix.

customExtensions.policy: Application-supplied descriptors/Any payloads are supported by T05. No third-party custom schema is a release generation input until explicitly locked.
